svg.text: The quantity check moved in front of the mutex, and failures now say what was
// Reserve takes qty units of sku out of stock, or fails without changing an
Checked before taking the lock, so a bad
request never waits on other writers.
Q: Does wrapping the error change what
> [margin q1] inventory/stock.go:39 in station reserve: Does wrapping the error change what callers see?
⏺ Only the message. The new error wraps the sentinel with
callers that branch on it keep working. The one thing that would break is a direct
comparison, and nothing in this repository does that.
Ask for a change, or press a on a line in the review…
